original_question: Carla na-ebudata failu nari GB abụọ. Ọ na ejikarị otu nkeji ebudata GB abụọ, mana  40% nke ụzọ site na mbudata, Windows na-amanye malitegharị n' isi n'ike iwebata ihe mmelite. nke were nkeji iri abụọ. Mgbe ahụ Carla malitegharịrị n' isi ime mbudata. Kedu oge ole owere iji budata failu ahụ?
question_template: {name_female, Carla} na-ebudata failu {num_digit_1, 200} GB. Ọ na ejikarị otu nkeji ebudata {num_digit_2, 2} GB, mana {num_digit_3, 40}% nke ụzọ site na mbudata, Windows na-amanye malitegharị n'isi n'ike iwebata ihe mmelite, nke na ewe nkeji {num_digit_4, 20}. Mgbe ahụ {name_female, Carla} malitegharịrị n'isi ime mbudata. Kedu oge ole owere iji budata failu ahụ?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1 * num_digit_3 / 100) / num_digit_2 + num_digit_4 + num_digit_1 / num_digit_2
